# 🌳 opencode-dir-tree-tui

English | 简体中文

Browse project files, track Git changes, copy paths, and open files and folders from the [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) terminal sidebar. ![File tree demo](assets/demo.gif) ## 📦 Install / update / remove Requires **OpenCode ≥ 2.0**. Terminal UI (TUI) only. ```bash opencode plugin add opencode-dir-tree-tui ``` - Update: `opencode plugin update opencode-dir-tree-tui` - Remove: `opencode plugin remove opencode-dir-tree-tui` If an update is not reflected, restart the TUI client, not just the server. On V1, pin `opencode-dir-tree-tui@0.5.1` and see the [V1 guide](https://github.com/aihaipeng/opencode-dir-tree-tui/blob/v0.5.1/README.md). ## ⚙️ Settings Run `/dirtree-sidebar` to open **Dir Tree Sidebar**. Use `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` or click to switch between **Settings** and **Ignore Rules**; `Esc` closes the panel. | Setting | Description | Available values | | --- | --- | --- | | Show file tree | Show/hide the tree and its title | `on` / `off` | | Open file | Open files with the system default app | `left-click` / `middle-click` / `right-click` / `off` | | Copy file path | Copy absolute file paths | `left-click` / `middle-click` / `right-click` / `off` | | Open folder | Open folders with the system default app | `left-click` / `middle-click` / `right-click` / `off` | | Copy folder path | Copy absolute folder paths | `left-click` / `middle-click` / `right-click` / `off` | | Expand/collapse folder | Expand/collapse folders | `left-click` / `middle-click` / `right-click` | Preferences save automatically and survive restarts. Mouse bindings are global; visibility and ignore rules are per-project, including its subdirectory sessions. Panel collapse is temporary and per-terminal. ## 💡 Notes ### Default mouse actions | Click target | Left-click | Middle-click | Right-click | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Folder | Expand / collapse | Copy its absolute path | Open with the system default app | | File | — | Copy its absolute path | Open with the system default app | The terminal must forward middle-click rather than use it for paste. Copying paths over SSH requires terminal OSC 52 support. ### Git colors | Color | Status | | --- | --- | | Theme accent | Folder | | Green | Added `A`, untracked `??`, renamed `R`, or copied `C` | | Yellow | Modified `M` or changed file type `T` | | Red | Deleted `D` or merge conflicts such as `UU` / `AA` / `DD` | | Gray | Git-ignored `!!`; not automatically hidden | Changed files also show Git status badges such as `M`, `??` or `MM`. ### Ignore rules Patterns follow `.gitignore` syntax; the `git` command must be available locally. | Example pattern | Effect | | --- | --- | | `node_modules/` | Hide `node_modules` folders at any depth | | `/dist/` | Hide only the root `dist` folder | | `*.log` | Hide files or folders ending in `.log` at any depth | | `!keep.log` | Place after `*.log` to show `keep.log` again | Rules only hide tree entries; they do not change Git tracking or import `.gitignore`. A parent folder must be visible before a child can be re-included. - The expanded tree refreshes on file changes and every 10 seconds. Rules saved in another TUI apply on refresh. - Git features and default-app opening require the workspace path to be locally accessible.

# 🌳 opencode-dir-tree-tui

English | 简体中文

在 [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) 终端侧栏浏览项目文件、查看 Git 变更、复制路径，并打开文件和文件夹。 ![文件树演示](assets/demo.gif) ## 📦 安装／更新／卸载 要求 **OpenCode ≥ 2.0**，仅适用于终端界面（TUI）。 ```bash opencode plugin add opencode-dir-tree-tui ``` - 更新：`opencode plugin update opencode-dir-tree-tui` - 卸载：`opencode plugin remove opencode-dir-tree-tui` 更新后若仍使用旧代码，请重启 TUI 客户端，而不是仅重启服务端。 V1 用户请固定使用 `opencode-dir-tree-tui@0.5.1`，参考 [V1 说明](https://github.com/aihaipeng/opencode-dir-tree-tui/blob/v0.5.1/README.zh-CN.md)。 ## ⚙️ 设置 运行 `/dirtree-sidebar` 打开 **Dir Tree Sidebar（目录树侧边栏）**。用 `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` 或鼠标点击切换 **Settings（设置）** 与 **Ignore Rules（忽略规则）**；`Esc` 关闭面板。 | 设置 | 说明 | 可选值 | | --- | --- | --- | | Show file tree | 显示／隐藏文件树及标题 | `on` / `off` | | Open file | 用系统默认程序打开文件 | `left-click` / `middle-click` / `right-click` / `off` | | Copy file path | 复制文件绝对路径 | `left-click` / `middle-click` / `right-click` / `off` | | Open folder | 用系统默认程序打开文件夹 | `left-click` / `middle-click` / `right-click` / `off` | | Copy folder path | 复制文件夹绝对路径 | `left-click` / `middle-click` / `right-click` / `off` | | Expand/collapse folder | 展开／折叠文件夹 | `left-click` / `middle-click` / `right-click` | 设置自动保存，重启后保留。鼠标绑定跨项目共用；显隐与忽略规则按项目保存，子目录会话共用所属项目的设置。面板折叠是临时状态，仅影响当前终端。 ## 💡 注意事项 ### 默认鼠标操作 | 点击位置 | 左键 | 中键 | 右键 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 目录 | 展开 / 折叠 | 复制绝对路径 | 用系统默认程序打开 | | 文件 | — | 复制绝对路径 | 用系统默认程序打开 | 终端必须转发中键，不能用它粘贴；SSH 复制路径需要终端支持 OSC 52。 ### Git 颜色 | 颜色 | 状态 | | --- | --- | | 主题强调色 | 目录 | | 绿色 | 新增 `A`、未跟踪 `??`、重命名 `R`、复制 `C` | | 黄色 | 修改 `M`、文件类型改变 `T` | | 红色 | 删除 `D`、合并冲突 `UU` / `AA` / `DD` 等 | | 灰色 | Git 忽略 `!!`，不自动隐藏 | 有变更的文件还会显示 `M`、`??`、`MM` 等 Git 状态标记。 ### 忽略规则 规则遵循 `.gitignore` 语法，需要本机可用的 `git` 命令。 | 规则示例 | 效果 | | --- | --- | | `node_modules/` | 隐藏任意层级的 `node_modules` 目录 | | `/dist/` | 仅隐藏项目根目录下的 `dist` 目录 | | `*.log` | 隐藏任意层级以 `.log` 结尾的文件或目录 | | `!keep.log` | 放在 `*.log` 后，恢复显示 `keep.log` | 规则只隐藏文件树条目，不改变 Git 追踪，也不导入 `.gitignore`。恢复子项前，其父目录必须可见。 - 面板展开时，文件变化会触发刷新，也会每 10 秒刷新一次；其他 TUI 保存的规则在刷新后生效。 - Git 功能和默认程序打开要求工作区路径在本机可访问。
